verdict.rationale: Rippling's docs describe the core pieces of an end-to-end payroll run — reviewing/approving hours and timesheets inside the pay run (rippling-docs-25, rippling-docs-4), comparing current vs previous runs to catch discrepancies (rippling-docs-1), adding one-off bonuses (rippling-docs-36), and running/submitting payroll on a flexible schedule (rippling-docs-38, rippling-docs-48). However, this is assembled from separate marketing bullet points rather than one documented unified workflow, and there is no explicit 'preview totals' screen or hands-on/independent walkthrough confirming the single-flow experience. missing for 10: a first-party step-by-step walkthrough showing hours→preview totals→submit as one screen/flow, and independent/hands-on confirmation of that flow.
